lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light above to shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, distinct high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily near the base and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark linear feature is visible near the distal tip of the left pectoral fin, indicating a potential minor lesion or parasitic attachment site.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are present: one attached to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin and others in close proximity to the head and ventral regions.
